Subject: HIPAA / BAA eligibility & next steps

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the security/compliance gating items cleared for procurement:

1) BAA eligibility: you mentioned Medwise will be sending PHI to the system. Please confirm that expectation (PHI in prompts, attachments, or both).
2) Deployment preferences: you indicated a preference for an isolated deployment. Can you confirm whether Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with VPC peering) or fully on-prem (air-gapped) is required? Our hosted public API is not eligible for PHI without a contractual BAA and dedicated/private deployment.
3) SOC 2: We can share a SOC 2 Type II summary. Is a SOC 2 report sufficient for your security team or do you need the full SOC 2 report and control mapping?
4) Vendor security questionnaire: attaching a short vendor security questionnaire you can populate (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). If it’s easier, we can set up a short meeting between your security buyer and our security lead.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Next steps: please confirm (a) PHI usage scope, (b) preferred deployment mode, and (c) timeline expectations for procurement. I’ll loop in our compliance lead if you confirm PHI requirements so we can share the BAA template and SOC 2 artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Confirming the following from our side:

- PHI scope: yes, we will be sending PHI in clinical notes and some lab result attachments (PDFs).
- Deployment: we prefer an isolated deployment. Ideally a VPC/private deployment that can be contracted (Dedicated or Private).
- SOC 2: our security team requires SOC 2 Type II. A summary is helpful for sales; procurement will ask for the full report or an SOC2 auditor contact.
- Timeline: procurement wants vendor responses within 2 weeks to keep our implementation window in Q3.

I’ll start a Vendor Security Questionnaire with our procurement lead (Sarah Hayes cc’d). Please send the BAA template and SOC 2 artifacts when available. Also include any notes on PHI handling boundaries and whether Redwood’s hosted API is an option under a BAA or if a dedicated/private deployment is mandatory.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Clinical Platforms | Medwise Health
